evidence.reason: The anchored assertions only require two distinct invocations and a record sequence above the baseline. Distinctness is checked with a set, so reversed ordering passes; the record sequence is never compared with the final log sequence for the same invocation, so a mismatched journal sequence also passes. The surrounding proof already uses the final log as the authority (`after_by_invocation`), so using the existing `validate_completed(..., unit=REPAIR_UNIT)` is a concrete correctness fix to the fence proof, not a new requirement.
